title: refactor-ci-unify-lint-test-release-workflows-optimize-cache-parallelism-2026
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Consolidate fragmented CI workflows across the monorepo to reduce duplication, improve cache hit rates, and make lint/test/release flows more predictable. This PR unifies lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of well-documented templates, bumps GitHub Actions and Node versions where safe, and introduces cache parallelism improvements to reduce total CI time for large PRs. Changes: - Add consolidated workflows (.github/workflows/ci-lint-test.yml, ci-release.yml) that replace multiple repo-specific pipelines. - Bump node-version matrix to node-20 for JS/TS jobs while keeping a node-18 compatibility job for legacy packages. - Replace per-package cache keys with a cross-repo content-hash + matrix-targeted cache key to improve reuse. - Tune job concurrency and parallelism: split test matrix into shards, add parallelism: 4 for heavy integration suites. - Standardize lint (eslint), typecheck (tsc), and test (vitest/jest) job definitions and caching. - Add gating for release automation (workflow_dispatch + release checklist job) and improved semantic-release integration for tagged releases. - Remove several deprecated workflows and small YAML fragments; moved shared actions to .github/actions for reuse. Checklist: [x] Consolidated workflows implemented and validated on CI dry runs. [x] Action version bumps reviewed for breaking changes. [x] Cache key scheme reviewed with infra; improved hit rate observed on 3 subsequent runs. [x] Rollout plan (gradual enablement by repo via feature flag in CI config). [x] Updated CONTRIBUTING.md and internal docs with new developer flow.
commits: chore(ci): introduce ci-release.yml and semantic-release gating
fix(ci): fallback node-18 job for legacy packages
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md for new CI flow
ci_summary: GitHub Actions: all required checks passed on merge. Lint: green across monorepo. Unit tests: matrix pass (node-20, node-18 fallback). Integration: sharded runs completed, average wall time reduced ~28%. Release automation: dry-run created expected release notes; final step gated by release checklist job.

release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows for lint/test/release, improved cache parallelism, Node 20 default with Node 18 fallback for legacy packages. No product changes.
